decision.summary: A temporary offset is confirmed in U (605–614) with supporting correlated behavior in N and E; the return begins at 615, evidenced by resumption of prior trend direction and slope in all axes. No other temporary intervals within allowed_context [570,650] meet full onset–sustained–return criteria.

intervals.observation: U shows a sustained drop (~1.5 MAD) from index ~605 to 614, holding near a lower level before resuming upward trend; N and E exhibit subtle but correlated shifts over the same span, without immediate reversal. Return is observed starting at index 615 (U rises, N/E resume prior trend), satisfying onset–interior–return structure on all three axes.
